summary: The retrieved web content is unsuitable for the requested operation.

match_any.description_exact: Bad Request: wrong type of the web page content

possible_causes: The retrieved page did not provide usable media for the operation.
diagnostic_limits: The mapping does not identify a required MIME type or prove which part of the retrieved content is unsuitable.

evidence.note: WEBPAGE_MEDIA_EMPTY is rewritten to this description.
The rewrite runs only after the error is normalized to code 400.
Adds the code-specific prefix and lowercases only the initial character of ordinary messages.

response.description: Bad Request: wrong type of the web page content

preconditions: Check that the URL serves the intended media and that the selected method accepts that media type.
